As tech giants push forward with their agendas, many residents are left questioning whether the expansion truly benefits their neighborhoods.

title: Emma Watson's £1m gift helps fund reach 46,100 women and girls

The fund has empowered over 20,000 professionals and donated almost £2.54 million to numerous organizations. With new legal obligations aimed at curbing workplace harassment, ongoing support for survivors and grassroots organizations remains critical. Collaborative efforts among charities and advocacy groups are vital for fostering enduring change.

title: 'Plane will be hijacked': Note found in toilet triggers mid-air scare on IndiGo flight
content: Passengers aboard IndiGo flight 6E 451 from Bengaluru to Lucknow experienced panic after a hijack threat note was found. The note was discovered in the aircraft toilet around thirty minutes after take-off, prompting immediate action. Cabin crew alerted the pilot, who decided to return to the Kempegowda International Airport for security checks. Security agencies conducted a thorough search, declaring the threat a hoax after ninety minutes.

title: Leonora Carrington painting kept by family for 70 years heads to auction
content: Fil d'Or is a unique artwork by Leonora Carrington with a fascinating backstory. It was purchased way back in 1953 and remained treasured by a single family for many years. This painting showcases a cool technique known as grattage, which is part of the Surrealist movement and provides insight into Carrington's distinctive and imaginative style. Now authenticated, Fil d’Or goes up for auction on November 10

title: UK manager fired over £21,000 pothole bills wins £34,326 unfair dismissal case
content: A Dundee transport manager who worked for a furniture company for over 24 years was dismissed after it questioned £21,360 in pothole repair bills. A tribunal found that the company had failed to investigate the matter fairly, overlooked findings that cleared him of wrongdoing and wrongly dismissed him. It ordered the company to pay him £34,326.

title: Michael Dell is funding South Korea's most-expensive divorce ever
content: Michael Dell is investing $406 million in SK Group by purchasing shares from chairman Chey Tae-won. This transaction involves a 1.34% stake in SK Inc, aimed to fund a divorce settlement. Chey Tae-won is selling shares totaling 944 billion won to pay his ex-wife. The investment showcases Dell's connection to SK Group through their partnership in technology infrastructure.

title: Brittany Mahomes faces backlash as Travis Kelce disagrees with Patrick Mahomes
content: Brittany Mahomes faced criticism after questioning the controversial false start penalty that wiped out Patrick Mahomes' potential game-winning touchdown against the Denver Broncos. Former Bengals star Chad Johnson defended the officials, insisting Jaylon Moore had flinched. Travis Kelce also agreed with the ruling, adding another twist to the debate. The Chiefs eventually suffered a 28-24 defeat, raising fresh questions about penalties and officiating.

title: Shilo Sanders slams $12,000 New York rent amid $11.89 million bankruptcy case
content: Shilo Sanders faces intense difficulties in securing an apartment in New York amidst soaring rental costs. Despite a robust budget of $12,000 per month, available options remain scarce. His brother, Shedeur Sanders, has generously stepped in to offer financial help with moving expenses. Compounding Shilo's challenges is an ongoing bankruptcy dispute, further complicating his quest for suitable housing in the competitive New York market.

title: In 2020, Patrick Mahomes bought a $3.37M mansion now estimated at $5.5M
content: In March 2020, Patrick Mahomes made headlines by acquiring a luxurious mansion in Westlake, Texas, for $3.37 million, notably less than its asking price. Current estimates place its value at around $5.5 million, showcasing a significant appreciation. This purchase aligned with his Super Bowl championship and lucrative contract extension with the Chiefs. The home boasts numerous upscale features in a prime location.

title: Adkar, Bhosale become first Indian women's pair to reach final at main WTA Tour level
content: India’s Vaishnavi Adkar and Rutuja Bhosale made history at the Chennai Open, becoming the first all-Indian women’s pair to reach a main WTA Tour doubles final. They defeated second seeds Weronika Falkowska and Alana Smith 6-2, 2-6, 10-8 after a thrilling comeback in the super tie-break. They will face Swiss duo Naima Karamoko and Simona Waltert in the final.

title: Tech exec murder: Victim's son hid behind parked cars as accused fired 15 rounds
content: Mohan Sharma allegedly shot his neighbor Paramjeet Dhankar following a dispute over vehicle parking. The altercation escalated after Dhankar's family previously reported tensions with Sharma's family. Eight days before the incident, repeated arguments occurred between both families regarding parking and a pet dog. Dhankar had just returned from Singapore to attend a family wedding when the shooting took place.

title: Zelenskyy says Russia hit Ukrainian energy facility with North Korean KN-23 missiles
content: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Russia is using North Korean KN-23 missiles against Ukraine. He emphasized the need for stronger global sanctions against countries supplying military assistance. Zelenskyy noted a critical shortage of US-made Patriot missile interceptors affecting Ukraine's defense capabilities. Russia's intensified attacks are exacerbating the situation as winter approaches. Military cooperation between North Korea and Russia has significantly increased in recent months.

title: Happy Diwali 2026: Vibrant Wishes, Messages, Quotes, Images to Share on WhatsApp

Known for its enlightening traditions, the festival bathes homes in light through diyas and colorful adornments. Emphasizing sustainability this year, communities are reminded to engage in meaningful acts of kindness, celebrating the true essence of joy and gratitude in every small moment.

title: 'A pleasure to watch him bat': Pathan hails KL Rahul's composure in tricky chase
content: KL Rahul proved to be a linchpin for India's ODI squad during the encounter against New Zealand. His unbeaten innings was pivotal amidst the early dismissals of his teammates, securing India’s victory through the DLS method. Meanwhile, New Zealand faltered at the crease, setting a modest target, while India's bowlers delivered with precision and vital wickets. Ultimately, India triumphed by a narrow margin of four runs despite challenging match conditions.

title: 10 yrs of JJ Act: Has the law helped kids reform or pushed more towards adult trials?
content: India's Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 emphasizes child rehabilitation over punishment. However, the effectiveness of juvenile homes and legal safeguards remains questionable after ten years. Significant issues include staff shortages and delays in processing cases, which hinder timely interventions. Many children are still not receiving adequate education and support in institutional care settings.

title: Why can't Congress break free from Gandhi family? Sonia responds to nepotism charge
content: Sonia Gandhi addressed questions about her family's leadership of the Congress party during an interview. She downplayed allegations of nepotism while asserting the party's potential to challenge the BJP. Gandhi reflected on her mother-in-law Indira Gandhi's Emergency decision and described it as a mistake. She recounted personal trauma from losing both Indira and her husband Rajiv Gandhi to assassinations.

title: Muhurat Trading 2026: Why Dalal Street opens for an hour on Diwali

This trading session reflects auspiciousness associated with the Diwali festival and investor optimism. Major indices have seen strong rallies leading up to this event, driven by foreign investments and stable domestic economic indicators. Analysts recommend focusing on quality stocks and maintaining disciplined asset allocation for the upcoming year.

Military forces from 11 different nations will engage in combined operations spanning land, air, and maritime areas. The exercise seeks to bolster international cooperation amongst these nations for future engagements.

title: Ayodhya glows with 30 lakh diyas as Deepotsav lights up Saryu ghats on Diwali eve

The annual celebration, which marks return of Lord Ram to Ayodhya after defeating Ravana, recreates the traditional welcome believed to have been given to him by the people of the city in the Treta Yuga.

title: Watch: Gukesh visits famous Tirumala temple ahead of World C'ship title defence

The 14-game championship will take place in Geneva from November 24 to December 12. Both players will be 20, making it the youngest World Championship clash in chess history. The tournament carries a USD 2.5 million prize fund.

title: 'Iron Gate': US forms special task force to restrict Iran's land exports

This task force will operate from Tampa, Florida, involving approximately 20 personnel from various US government agencies. The initiative aims to further restrict Iran's capabilities to finance terrorism and rebuild military resources. Washington continues its naval blockade, reportedly preventing over $25 billion in crude oil exports.

Forensic teams collected evidence, and CCTV footage is being analyzed to track suspicious activities. title: Pakistan to send astronaut to China’s space station aboard Shenzhou-24 mission
content: the astronaut will undertake a short-term stay in orbit before returning to earth aboard the shenzhou-24 spacecraft . the mission will mark the first joint spaceflight involving Chinese and foreign astronauts in the history of china's manned space programme .

title: New Zealand govt holds narrow lead in poll nailbiter
content:
.

New Zealand's centre-right governing coalition has a path to return to power after taking a narrow lead in a closely fought election. With 97% of the vote counted early Sunday, National Party and its allies the libertarian ACT party and the nationalist New Zealand First party have 67 seats between them, enough to govern in a 130-seat parliament. But that small majority could yet be overturned when special ballots are counted, and the opposition hasn't conceded defeat. "It is heartening to see that on the numbers so far, National is once again the largest party in parliament, and we have a pathway to forming the next government," Prime Minister Christopher Luxon said. One of the big stories of the night was the rise of the centrist Opportunity Party, which will enter parliament for the first time and could end up holding the balance of power once the final result is known at the end of the month.

End of Article

title: US military looks to curb Iranian land commerce
content:
.

After a months-long naval blockade on Iran, the US military is setting up a task force to bolster Washington's efforts to restrict Tehran's movement of advanced weapons systems and other sanctioned material across its land borders and Caspian Sea. The announcement of the task force, which has not been previously reported, will be made later on Saturday by US Central Command, according to a statement seen by Reuters ahead of its release. Task Force Iron Gate, as it will be called, will be based in Tampa, Florida, and will coordinate with other US govt agencies. Beyond movement of weapons, it will also focus on dual-use and illegal revenue streams. "Strengthening CENTCOM's collaboration with US interagency partners will further constrain Iran's ability to finance terrorism, rebuild weapons factories, and replenish their military," Admiral Brad Cooper, the commander of Central Command, said in a statement.

End of Article
